issues.title: Last backup of default/shop-api-pg was 31 h ago
issues.cause: Expected at least every 26 h. Is the ScheduledBackup still running?

issues.title: Certificate translate.shop.example expires in 9 days
issues.cause: Automatic renewal should have kicked in long ago (planned: 2026-11-03). Check the cert-manager logs and the challenges.

issues.title: An API in use is gone in Kubernetes 1.38
issues.cause: Since the API server last started, something asked for resource.k8s.io/v1beta1 deviceclasses; 1.38 removes them. The API server's audit log names what asked (a chart, an operator, a script). Move it over first, then upgrade.

issues.title: Argo CD app weblate-chart: change waiting for sync
issues.cause: Manual sync: the repository holds a change that has not been rolled out yet. Not an error, just so you know.
